menus.name: Bike Warm-up: On-the-Bike 6 min

segments.name: Easy spin
segments.description: Spin slowly in your lightest gear to wake up the legs and heart rate

segments.name: Cadence build
segments.description: Keep the gear light and raise cadence (target ~90rpm). Relax the upper body

segments.name: Shift up and cruise
segments.description: Shift 1-2 gears harder and cruise at a pace where breathing quickens slightly

segments.name: High-cadence drill
segments.description: 30 seconds of high cadence (~100rpm) in a light gear. Stay smooth in the saddle

segments.name: Soft pedal
segments.description: Pedal lightly and settle your breathing

segments.name: Build-up
segments.description: Build to about 80% effort to be ready for Main 1

menus.description: A warm-up done entirely on the bike. Build gradually from your lightest gear and finish ready for Main 1. Approx. calories: 25-35 kcal

menus.name: Bike Main 1: High-Intensity Pedaling

segments.name: High-intensity pedaling
segments.description: Push at 80-90% effort in a harder gear. Stay seated with a stable upper body

segments.name: Recovery spin
segments.description: Spin easy in a light gear, recover your breathing for the next rep

menus.description: Prep (1 min): spin in a light gear, settle breathing, check the road ahead. 8 reps of 40s hard + 20s easy. Cooldown (1 min): shift light and loosen the legs before Main 2. Approx. calories: 100-140 kcal (varies with weight/intensity)

menus.name: Bike Main 2: Upper Body & Core

segments.name: Front lift
segments.description: On a safe straight at low speed: draw the bars in lightly and hold your torso with the core, not the arms

segments.name: Soft pedal
segments.description: Pedal lightly and release tension in shoulders and arms

menus.description: Prep (1 min): shift light and check bar pressure and core engagement. 7 reps of 40s work + 20s easy. Cooldown (1 min): relax the upper body and roll into the final cooldown. Approx. calories: 60-80 kcal

menus.name: Bike Cooldown: On-the-Bike 5 min

segments.name: Easy spin-down
segments.description: Light gear at ~60rpm to bring the heart rate down

segments.name: Calf release (right)
segments.description: On a safe straight, stand on the pedals and drop the right heel to stretch the calf

segments.name: Calf release (left)
segments.description: Repeat with the left heel dropped deep

segments.name: Shoulder & neck reset
segments.description: While stopped or somewhere safe, release one hand at a time and roll the shoulders to loosen the neck and traps

segments.name: Back & pelvis reset
segments.description: Alternate rounding and gently arching the back to release the posture held during riding

segments.name: Final easy spin
segments.description: Spin gently until breathing is fully settled, then finish

menus.description: An on-the-bike cooldown for the legs, calves and shoulders used through Warm-up, Main 1 and Main 2. Approx. calories: 20-30 kcal
